title: DataPass built-in baseline
description: Descriptions and dated prices of the tools DataPass knows without a hub. Prices were read on the vendors' pages on 2026-09-26; a figure that could not be confirmed there is written unknown. A hub repository's .datapass/toolkit/tools.json overrides any entry.

tools.freeTier: The VS Code extension itself is free; it needs a Fabric capacity (trial or paid) or a Fabric workspace to be useful.
tools.note: The tool is free; the Fabric capacity (F SKU, or a trial) it works against is billed separately: see the Fabric pricing page.

tools.freeTier: The extension is free; it needs a Fabric capacity (trial or paid) or Fabric workspace to run notebooks/pipelines.
tools.note: The tool is free; the Fabric capacity (F SKU, or a trial) it works against is billed separately: see the Fabric pricing page.

tools.freeTier: Free, open-source VS Code extension for running Jupyter notebooks.
Free, open-source Python language support extension for VS Code.
Microsoft Build of OpenJDK is a free, no-cost OpenJDK distribution.
Free community VS Code extension by Gerhard Brueckl for managing a Fabric tenant; needs a Fabric tenant/capacity to connect to.
tools.note: Community-maintained (gbrueckl), not an official Microsoft product; free to install, requires Fabric access.
tools.useWhen: Edit an item definition without Git, run REST calls, manage deployment pipelines from VS Code.
tools.avoidWhen: The workspace is connected to Git: edit the files in the repository instead.

tools.freeTier: OneLake explorer functionality is bundled free within Fabric Studio; needs a Fabric workspace/OneLake to browse.
tools.note: Not a separate product; it's the OneLake browser feature inside Gerhard Brueckl's Fabric Studio extension.

tools.freeTier: Microsoft's official open-source Fabric CLI (package ms-fabric-cli) is free; needs a Fabric capacity/workspace to operate against.
tools.note: The tool is free; the Fabric capacity (F SKU, or a trial) it works against is billed separately: see the Fabric pricing page.

tools.freeTier: Python interpreter/runtime is free and open source.
Azure CLI itself is free; usage costs come only from the Azure resources it manages.
The VS Code Databricks extension is free; it needs a Databricks workspace (Free Edition or paid) to connect to.
tools.note: See cli.databricks note for Databricks workspace pricing.

tools.freeTier: The Databricks CLI is free; it needs a Databricks workspace. Free Edition workspaces exist for non-commercial learning; production use is pay-as-you-go DBU.

tiers.name: Free Edition
features: No AI features requiring paid compute

tiers.name: Pay-as-you-go (Jobs Compute)
tiers.price: unknown (not confirmed on the official page on 2026-09-26)

tiers.name: Pay-as-you-go (All-Purpose Compute)
tiers.price: unknown (not confirmed on the official page on 2026-09-26)

tiers.name: Serverless SQL
tiers.price: unknown (not confirmed on the official page on 2026-09-26)

tools.note: Prices of paid tiers change often; check the official pricing page.

tools.freeTier: Free VS Code extension providing TMDL language support.
Power BI Desktop is free to download and use for building reports on your own machine; sharing/collaboration needs Pro or PPU licences.

tiers.name: Free account
features: Build reports in Power BI Desktop

tiers.name: Fabric/Premium capacity (F/P SKUs)
features: Org-wide capacity, free viewers with F64+

tools.note: Desktop itself never costs money; pricing shown is for sharing/collaboration tiers.

tools.freeTier: Tabular Editor 2 is free and open source; Tabular Editor 3 is a paid commercial tool with subscription editions.

tiers.name: TE3 Desktop
tiers.price: unknown (price shown dynamically on site, not captured)

tiers.name: TE3 Business
tiers.price: unknown (price shown dynamically on site, not captured)

tools.note: TE3 Desktop/Business exact list prices are rendered dynamically via JS and were not readable from the fetched page; only Enterprise tier pricing was confirmed. Recheck tabulareditor.com/pricing directly for current Desktop/Business figures.

tools.freeTier: GitHub Copilot Free gives 2,000 completions and 50 chat requests/month, usable from the Copilot CLI.

tiers.name: Free
features: CLI and agent mode included, limited quota

tiers.name: Pro
features: USD 15/month total AI credits (10 base + 5 flex)

tools.note: As of mid-2026 GitHub moved billing from 'premium request' units to token-based 'AI Credits'; a Max plan (USD 100/month) also exists for heavy agent usage.

tools.freeTier: A plain workspace/config file, no cost.
Grafana's gcx CLI (Grafana Cloud extensions tool) is free to use.
tools.note: Interacts with Grafana Cloud, which has its own paid tiers (see ext.grafana).

tools.freeTier: OpenTofu is a free, open-source (MPL-2.0) Terraform fork with no paid tiers.
The Terraform CLI itself is free (BSL license, local use); HCP Terraform (formerly Terraform Cloud) adds paid managed tiers.
tools.note: Terraform CLI itself has no cost; figures above are for the optional HCP Terraform managed service.

tools.freeTier: Container Tools extension for VS Code is free.
Remote-SSH VS Code extension is free.
OpenSSH is free, open-source software.
The MongoDB VS Code extension is free; it needs a MongoDB server or Atlas cluster (free M0 available) to connect to.
mongosh (MongoDB Shell) is free; it needs a MongoDB server/Atlas cluster to connect to (Atlas M0 free tier available).
tools.note: The shell itself is free; pricing shown is for the Atlas cluster it typically connects to.

tools.freeTier: Draw.io Integration VS Code extension is free.
Git is free, open-source software.
Azure Functions VS Code extension is free; deploying to Azure incurs Functions/Storage costs (Consumption plan has a free monthly grant).
Azure Functions Core Tools is a free local CLI/runtime; only deployment to Azure incurs cost.
Azure Storage VS Code extension is free; actual Azure Storage usage is billed (no dedicated always-free storage tier outside the Azure free account credits).
tools.note: Azure Storage has no standing 'always free' quota beyond the general Azure free account's $200 credit / limited free amounts for 12 months.

tools.freeTier: The Azure Cosmos DB extension is free; Cosmos DB itself offers a lifetime free tier of 1000 RU/s and 25 GB storage per account.

tiers.name: Free tier
tiers.price: USD 0 (first 1000 RU/s + 25 GB, lifetime, 1 per subscription)
features: Usage above the free amount billed at normal rates

tools.freeTier: Azure Resources VS Code extension is free (browsing/managing Azure resources).
Microsoft's PostgreSQL VS Code extension is free.
Neon has a free tier (100 CU-hours/month, 0.5 GB storage) usable with any Postgres client/extension.

tiers.name: Scale
features: IP allow rules, private networking, uptime SLA

tools.freeTier: psql is the free, open-source PostgreSQL command-line client.
Docker Personal is free for individuals, small businesses (<250 employees and <$10M revenue), students/educators, and non-commercial open source.
The Google Cloud Data Agent Kit extension is free; it operates against Google Cloud data services which are billed per Google Cloud pricing (with an Always Free tier for some services).
tools.note: Could not confirm an official marketplace listing/pricing page specifically for 'Google Cloud Data Agent Kit' extension; treat name/version as unverified.

tools.freeTier: gcloud CLI is free; Google Cloud offers an Always Free tier (e.g. 1 e2-micro VM, 5GB Cloud Storage, 1TB BigQuery queries/month) plus a $300 free trial credit for new accounts.

tiers.name: Free trial
features: Applies to most Google Cloud services

tools.freeTier: GitHub Actions VS Code extension is free; underlying Actions minutes billing depends on the GitHub plan (see note).
tools.note: GitHub Actions is free for public repos on GitHub-hosted runners; private repos get included minutes/month: Free 2,000, Pro/Team 3,000, Enterprise Cloud 50,000, beyond which standard per-minute rates apply.

tools.freeTier: GitHub Pull Requests and Issues VS Code extension is free.
Azure Pipelines VS Code extension is free; Azure Pipelines itself gives 1 free Microsoft-hosted parallel job with 1,800 minutes/month for private projects.

tiers.name: Free (private projects)
features: May require a one-time free-grant request for new orgs

tiers.name: Additional Microsoft-hosted parallel job
features: Up to 360 min/run, no monthly cap

tools.freeTier: GitLab Workflow VS Code extension is free; GitLab.com has a Free tier for the platform itself.

tiers.name: Free
features: Core SCM/CI, 5 users per top-level namespace on SaaS

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.price: unknown (not confirmed on the official page on 2026-09-26)
features: Advanced CI/CD, code owners, multiple approval rules

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.price: unknown (not confirmed on the official page on 2026-09-26)

tools.note: Prices of paid tiers change often; check the official pricing page.

tools.freeTier: Grafana VS Code extension is free; Grafana Cloud has an always-free tier (10k metrics series, 50GB logs/traces/profiles, 14-day retention, 3 users).
Free community VS Code extension by Gerhard Brueckl for managing a Power BI tenant/TMDL editing; needs a Power BI tenant (Pro/PPU/capacity) to publish against.
tools.note: Community-maintained, not an official Microsoft extension.

tools.freeTier: Gerhard Brueckl's Power BI/Fabric Studio and OneLake explorer VS Code extensions are free to install; using them against Power BI/Fabric requires an existing licensed tenant/capacity.
tools.note: Bundles ext.fabric-studio, ext.onelake and ext.powerbi-studio under one community author.

tools.freeTier: Microsoft's Power BI Modeling MCP server is free and open source; it needs Power BI Desktop locally or a Fabric/Power BI workspace for the remote variant.
tools.note: Public preview as of research date; local mode needs Power BI Desktop, remote (hosted) mode needs a Fabric workspace.

tools.freeTier: fabric-cicd is a free, open-source (MIT) Python library by Microsoft for Fabric CI/CD.
tools.note: The library is free; deploying to Fabric still runs against a billed Fabric capacity.
tools.useWhen: Deploy the items of a Fabric Git folder to dev, test and prod, with parameter.yml replacing ids per environment.

tools.freeTier: semantic-link-labs is a free, open-source Python library by Microsoft, installed via pip/PyPI.
tools.note: Runs inside Fabric notebooks, which consume Fabric capacity (billed separately).

tools.freeTier: The data-goblin Power BI/Fabric agentic-development plugin marketplace is free and open source on GitHub; it requires Claude Code to run, which itself needs a Claude Pro or Max (or Team/Enterprise) subscription for meaningful usage limits.

tiers.name: Claude Free
features: Basic Claude access; Claude Code usage very limited

tiers.name: Claude Pro
features: Claude Code included with standard usage limits

tiers.name: Claude Max 5x
features: 5x usage vs Pro for Claude Code

tiers.name: Claude Max 20x
tiers.price: unknown (not readable on the official page on 2026-09-26)

tools.note: The plugin itself is free; cost comes from the Claude subscription needed to run Claude Code with adequate usage limits. Re-check claude.com/pricing directly for the exact Max 20x figure before relying on it.
